name: DataXion Tunis Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral Tunis facility marketed by DataXion; aggregate listing places it in El Agba/Tunis. Capacity not publicly stated in reviewed sources.

name: Tunisie Telecom Carthage Data Center
notes: Tunisie Telecom markets national data-center and cloud services; third-party facility listing identifies the Carthage Data Center in Tunis. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ATLAX Tunis Data Center
notes: ATLAX lists Tunisia data-center services; Inflect facility profile reports the Tunis site at 1.5 MW. Treat as aggregate-confirmed pending direct technical sheet.

name: Syntys Charguia Data Center
notes: Iron Mountain announced a joint venture with Ooredoo subsidiary Syntys, whose portfolio includes Tunis-area data centers; aggregate facility listing identifies Syntys Charguia. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SIBTEL Data Center
notes: Tunisian interbank card-processing operator SIBTEL announced a new data center in 2018. Public source does not disclose IT load or exact governorate address; assigned to Tunis based on SIBTEL headquarters and banking-infrastructure context.

name: Syntys Sidi Rezig Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo data-center portfolio facility listed at Sidi Rezig, Megrine, in Ben Arous governorate. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Syntys Mghira Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo data-center portfolio facility listed at Mghira/Fouchana in Ben Arous governorate. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Syntys Manouba Data Center
notes: Syntys/Ooredoo data-center portfolio facility listed in Manouba governorate. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SoleCrypt-Schneider Electric Sustainable AI Data Centre, Bizerte
notes: MOU announced for a renewable-powered AI data-center project in Bizerte, with reported 20 MW initial capacity and scalable design.
